u0: No immediate response to a box fall is pending. If the box slips from your hands, the one-step window to recover it begins. Otherwise this state simply persists, and there is no mandatory completion goal in this preference-only task.
u1: The box has just fallen, so the next step is the immediate opportunity to pick it up again. If that next step finds you holding the box without another fall, the preference is kept and you return to the neutral state. If you remain empty-handed, the preference is broken and you return to the neutral state with a penalty. A second fall during this window also breaks the pending preference and returns you to neutral.
